display_information.name: Proximity Office
display_information.description: Photos and "Message on Slack" in Proximity Office, plus its DMs
display_information.long_description: The Slack side of Proximity Office (your virtual office). It looks people up by email for their photo, title and Slack id, so the office can show faces and a Message on Slack button. It sends DMs only: Fathom notes after a recorded room, and time-tracking decisions (leave, swaps, timesheets). It reads no channels and posts in none.
